skill.summary: Apply PEP 8 Python code style standards when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Python code. Use this skill when the user asks to enforce Python coding style...

latestVersion.changelog:
python-code-guide-skill 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Introduces the python-pep8-style skill, based on the official PEP 8 Python style guide.
- Enforces rules for code layout, indentation, line length, whitespace, naming, comments, and best practices.
- Supports code review, formatting checks, refactoring, and generation of PEP 8-compliant Python code.
- Detailed explanations and examples included for indentation, line breaks, and other formatting standards.
